<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>A Surprise For Khadija</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,500&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,600;0,700;1,600&family=Quicksand:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --plum-dark:#2b0a1f;
    --plum:#3f1330;
    --burgundy:#7a2245;
    --rose:#c6577d;
    --rose-soft:#e6a4bd;
    --blush:#f7dbe5;
    --cream:#fff6f1;
    --gold:#d9a857;
    --gold-soft:#f0d9ae;
    --shadow:rgba(43,10,31,.35);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
  body{
    font-family:'Quicksand',sans-serif;
    background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, #4a1735 0%, #2b0a1f 55%, #1c0715 100%);
    color:var(--cream);
    min-height:100vh;
    overflow-x:hidden;
    position:relative;
  }
  h1,h2,.display{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;}
  .script-text{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;}
  #app{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    height:100vh;
    height:100dvh;
    min-height:100vh;
    perspective:1900px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  #app::before{
    /* book spine shadow, persistent across pages */
    content:''; position:fixed; top:0; bottom:0; left:0; width:26px; z-index:10; pointer-events:none;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,.45), rgba(0,0,0,0));
  }
  .photo-backdrop{
    position:absolute; inset:-6%; z-index:0; background-size:cover; background-position:center 20%;
    filter:blur(34px) brightness(.5) saturate(1.1); opacity:0; transition:opacity 1.1s ease;
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .photo-backdrop.show{ opacity:.5; }
  .photo-backdrop::after{
    content:''; position:absolute; inset:0;
    background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, rgba(74,23,53,.35) 0%, rgba(43,10,31,.85) 60%, rgba(28,7,21,.96) 100%);
  }
  .screen{
    display:none;
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;
    width:100%;
    padding:32px 20px 56px;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:flex-start;
    text-align:center;
    z-index:2;
    overflow-y:auto;
    overflow-x:hidden;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
    background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, #4a1735 0%, #2b0a1f 55%, #1c0715 100%);
    backface-visibility:hidden;
    transform-origin:left center;
    transform:rotateY(0deg);
    box-shadow:none;
  }
  .screen.active{ display:flex; opacity:1; z-index:3; }
  .screen.leaving{
    display:flex; opacity:1; z-index:5; pointer-events:none;
    transform:rotateY(-124deg);
    transition:transform .68s cubic-bezier(.55,.06,.4,.99);
    box-shadow:60px 0 90px rgba(0,0,0,.55), inset -40px 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  }
  .page-corner{
    position:fixed; right:14px; bottom:14px; z-index:9; width:34px; height:34px; pointer-events:none;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 50%, rgba(255,246,241,.14) 51%, rgba(255,246,241,.28) 100%);
    border-radius:0 0 4px 0; opacity:.7;
  }
  .fade-in{animation:fadeIn .9s ease both;}
  @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);}}

  /* ambient background layer shared across screens */
  #ambient{position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:1; overflow:hidden;}
  .amb-item{position:absolute; opacity:.55; will-change:transform;}
  .amb-star{color:var(--gold-soft); filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(217,168,87,.7));}
  .amb-heart{color:var(--rose-soft); filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(198,87,125,.6));}

  .eyebrow{
    letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase; font-size:11px;
    color:var(--gold); font-weight:600; margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  h1.title{ font-size:clamp(28px,7vw,40px); margin:6px 0 10px; line-height:1.15;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%, var(--rose-soft) 120%);
    -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent;
    text-shadow:0 2px 24px rgba(198,87,125,.25);
  }
  .subtitle{font-size:16px; color:var(--blush); opacity:.85; max-width:320px; margin:0 auto 26px; line-height:1.5;}
  .swipe-hint{ font-size:13px; color:var(--gold-soft); opacity:.8; margin:-16px 0 18px; letter-spacing:.02em; animation:hintDrift 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes hintDrift{ 0%,100%{ transform:translateX(0); opacity:.55;} 50%{ transform:translateX(-6px); opacity:.95;} }

  .glow-btn{
    font-family:'Quicksand',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:15px;
    color:var(--plum-dark); background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold-soft),var(--gold));
    border:none; padding:15px 30px; border-radius:999px; cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(217,168,87,.35), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25) inset;
    transition:transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
    letter-spacing:.02em;
    touch-action:manipulation;
    position:relative;
  }
  .glow-btn:active{transform:scale(.96);}
  .glow-btn.secondary{
    background:transparent; color:var(--cream);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px rgba(247,219,229,.5) inset;
  }
  .glow-btn:disabled{opacity:.4; pointer-events:none;}

  .card{
    background:linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,.08), rgba(255,255,255,.03));
    border:1px solid rgba(247,219,229,.18);
    border-radius:26px; padding:24px; backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    box-shadow:0 20px 50px var(--shadow);
  }

  /* ---------- SCREEN 1 : WELCOME ---------- */
  .gift-wrap{ width:150px; height:150px; margin:26px auto 30px; position:relative; cursor:pointer;}
  .gift-lid{
    position:absolute; top:0; left:-8px; right:-8px; height:38px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--rose),var(--burgundy));
    border-radius:10px; box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    transform-origin:left center; transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
    z-index:3;
  }
  .gift-box{
    position:absolute; top:34px; left:0; right:0; bottom:0;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--burgundy),var(--plum));
    border-radius:8px 8px 14px 14px; box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  }
  .gift-ribbon-v{ position:absolute; top:34px; bottom:0; left:50%; width:16px; margin-left:-8px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold-soft),var(--gold)); }
  .gift-ribbon-h{ position:absolute; top:0; left:-8px; right:-8px; height:16px; margin-top:11px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold-soft),var(--gold)); z-index:4;}
  .gift-bow{ position:absolute; top:-20px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); font-size:34px; z-index:4; filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.3));}
  .gift-wrap.opened .gift-lid{ transform:translateY(-70px) rotate(-35deg); opacity:0;}
  .gift-wrap.opened .gift-bow{ transform:translate(-50%,-90px) rotate(20deg); opacity:0; transition:all .7s ease;}
  .gift-glow{ position:absolute; inset:-30px; border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(217,168,87,.55), transparent 65%); opacity:0; transition:opacity .5s ease;}
  .gift-wrap.opened .gift-glow{ opacity:1;}
  .music-hint{ margin-top:18px; font-size:13px; color:var(--blush); opacity:.7; background:none; border:1px solid rgba(247,219,229,.4); border-radius:999px; padding:8px 16px; cursor:pointer;}

  /* ---------- SCREEN 1 : SCENIC PIGEON JOURNEY ---------- */
  .scene-sky{
    position:relative; width:100%; max-width:420px; height:280px; margin:18px auto 10px;
    border-radius:24px; overflow:hidden;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #2b0a1f 0%, #5a2244 42%, #8a4162 68%, #c4808f 100%);
    box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(247,219,229,.12);
  }
  .scene-glow{ position:absolute; right:14%; top:12%; width:70px; height:70px; border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(240,217,174,.85), rgba(240,217,174,0) 70%); filter:blur(2px);}
  .scene-cloud{ position:absolute; background:rgba(255,255,255,.16); border-radius:50%; filter:blur(1px);}
  .scene-cloud.c1{ width:70px; height:22px; left:8%; top:30%; animation:cloudDrift 14s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .scene-cloud.c2{ width:50px; height:16px; left:55%; top:18%; animation:cloudDrift 11s ease-in-out infinite reverse;}
  .scene-cloud.c3{ width:60px; height:18px; left:30%; top:62%; animation:cloudDrift 16s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes cloudDrift{ 0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);} 50%{transform:translateX(14px);} }
  .flight-path{ position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%;}
  .location-tag{ position:absolute; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:var(--gold-soft); letter-spacing:.02em;
    background:rgba(43,10,31,.45); padding:4px 10px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid rgba(247,219,229,.2);}
  .location-tag.start{ left:5%; top:66%; }
  .location-tag.end{ right:4%; top:48%; }
  .pigeon{ position:absolute; left:8%; top:22%; font-size:30px; z-index:3;
    animation:flyPath 4.6s ease-in-out forwards; filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4));}
  .pigeon-face{ display:inline-block; transform:scaleX(-1); }
  .pigeon-envelope{ position:absolute; font-size:13px; left:50%; top:60%; transform:translateX(-50%);}
  @keyframes flyPath{
    0%{ left:8%; top:64%; transform:scale(.85) rotate(-8deg);}
    22%{ left:28%; top:22%; transform:scale(1) rotate(6deg);}
    46%{ left:48%; top:38%; transform:scale(1.05) rotate(-4deg);}
    70%{ left:68%; top:16%; transform:scale(1) rotate(5deg);}
    100%{ left:84%; top:44%; transform:scale(.92) rotate(0deg);}
  }
  .envelope-drop{ position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:8%; transform:translate(-50%,10px); text-align:center;
    opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease; z-index:4;}
  .envelope-drop.show{ opacity:1; transform:translate(-50%,0); pointer-events:auto;}
  .mini-envelope{ width:120px; height:80px; margin:0 auto; position:relative; cursor:pointer;}
  .mini-env-back{ position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eecad9,#f6dce6); border-radius:6px; box-shadow:0 12px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
  .mini-env-flap{ position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:0; border-left:60px solid transparent; border-right:60px solid transparent;
    border-top:42px solid #e9b9cf; transform-origin:top; transition:transform .55s ease; z-index:3;}
  .mini-env-letter{ position:absolute; left:8px; right:8px; bottom:4px; height:54px; background:#fffaf5; border-radius:4px;
    box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2); transition:transform .55s ease .08s; z-index:2;}
  .mini-envelope.opened .mini-env-flap{ transform:rotateX(180deg);}
  .mini-envelope.opened .mini-env-letter{ transform:translateY(-34px);}
  .mini-seal{ position:absolute; top:16px; left:50%; transform:translate(-50%,0); width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold-soft),var(--gold)); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-size:12px; z-index:4; box-shadow:0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.3);}
  .envelope-hint{ margin-top:10px; font-size:13px; color:var(--gold-soft); opacity:.9; animation:hintDrift 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;}

  /* ---------- SCREEN 3 : CAKE ---------- */
  .cake-wrap{ position:relative; margin:30px auto 20px; width:220px;}
  .cake{ position:relative; }
  .tier{ margin:0 auto; border-radius:10px; box-shadow:inset 0 -6px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.15), 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3);}
  .tier1{ width:220px; height:60px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fbe2ea,#f3b9cd);}
  .tier2{ width:170px; height:54px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f6c9db,#e88fab); margin-top:-4px;}
  .tier3{ width:120px; height:44px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f1a9c4,#d9688f); margin-top:-4px;}
  .candles{ display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:14px; margin-bottom:-6px; position:relative; z-index:2;}
  .candle{ width:6px; height:34px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold-soft),var(--gold)); border-radius:3px; position:relative; cursor:pointer;}
  .flame{ position:absolute; top:-16px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); width:12px; height:18px; border-radius:50% 50% 50% 50%/60% 60% 40% 40%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 70%, #fff2b0, #f7b733 60%, #e2571c); box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(247,183,51,.8); transition:opacity .3s ease, transform .3s ease;}
  .candle.blown .flame{ opacity:0; transform:translate(-50%,-8px) scale(.3);}
  .candle.blown::after{ content:''; position:absolute; top:-14px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); width:10px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(255,255,255,.35); filter:blur(1px); animation:smoke 1s ease forwards;}
  @keyframes smoke{ from{opacity:.6; transform:translate(-50%,-10px) scale(1);} to{opacity:0; transform:translate(-50%,-40px) scale(2);} }
  .make-wish{ margin-top:22px; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-style:italic; font-size:24px; color:var(--gold-soft);
    opacity:0; transform:translateY(10px) scale(.9); transition:opacity .5s ease, transform .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
    text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(217,168,87,.5);}
  .make-wish.show{ opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) scale(1);}
  .candle-hint{ margin-top:14px; font-size:13px; color:var(--blush); opacity:.75; letter-spacing:.02em; transition:opacity .4s ease;}
  .candle-hint.hide{ opacity:0;}

  /* ---------- SCREEN 4 : MEMORIES ---------- */
  .gallery{ display:flex; gap:18px; overflow-x:auto; scroll-snap-type:x mandatory; width:100%; padding:20px 10vw 10px; margin:0 -20px; }
  .gallery::-webkit-scrollbar{ display:none;}
  .polaroid{
    flex:0 0 78vw; max-width:280px; scroll-snap-align:center; background:#fffaf6; border-radius:6px;
    padding:12px 12px 20px; box-shadow:0 18px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4); transform:rotate(var(--tilt,-2deg));
    transition:transform .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease; cursor:pointer; position:relative;
  }
  .polaroid img{ width:100%; height:280px; object-fit:cover; object-position:center 18%; border-radius:2px; display:block;}
  .polaroid figcaption{ font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-style:italic; color:#5a3345; font-size:16px; margin-top:10px;}
  .polaroid.tapped{ transform:rotate(0deg) scale(1.04); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(217,168,87,.6), 0 24px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);}
  .dots-row{ display:flex; gap:6px; margin-top:14px;}
  .dots-row span{ width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:rgba(247,219,229,.35);}

  /* ---------- SCREEN 5 : BALLOONS ---------- */
  .balloon-field{ position:relative; width:100%; max-width:360px; height:390px; margin:10px auto 10px;}
  .balloon{
    position:absolute; width:64px; height:78px; border-radius:50% 50% 50% 50%/58% 58% 42% 42%;
    cursor:pointer; box-shadow:inset -8px -8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.15), inset 8px 8px 16px rgba(255,255,255,.25), 0 10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
    animation:float 4.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .balloon::after{ content:''; position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:-16px; width:2px; height:16px; background:rgba(247,219,229,.5); transform:translateX(-50%);}
  .balloon.pop{ animation:pop .35s ease forwards;}
  @keyframes pop{ to{ transform:scale(1.5); opacity:0;} }
  @keyframes float{ 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);} 50%{transform:translateY(-14px);} }
  .counter-pill{ display:inline-block; margin:6px 0 4px; padding:7px 18px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border:1px solid rgba(247,219,229,.25); font-weight:700; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:.03em;}
  .wish-toast{
    position:fixed; z-index:20; width:180px; max-width:52vw;
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff3f7,#fbe0ea); color:#5a2340; border-radius:16px; padding:12px 14px;
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.3; font-style:italic; box-shadow:0 16px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
    opacity:0; transform:translate(-50%,-6px) scale(.9); pointer-events:none;
    transition:opacity .35s ease, transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
  }
  .wish-toast.show{ opacity:1; transform:translate(-50%,-18px) scale(1);}

  /* ---------- SCREEN 7 : SCRATCH CARD ---------- */
  .scratch-wrap{ position:relative; width:280px; height:200px; margin:20px auto; border-radius:20px; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
  .scratch-under{ position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; text-align:center; padding:20px;
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff3f7,#f8d9e6); color:#5a2340; font-family:'Playfair Display'; font-size:22px; font-weight:700;}
  .scratch-canvas{ position:absolute; inset:0; touch-action:none;}

  /* ---------- SCREEN 8 : LETTER ---------- */
  .envelope{ width:260px; height:170px; margin:26px auto 14px; position:relative; cursor:pointer;}
  .env-back{ position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eecad9,#f6dce6); border-radius:8px; box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
  .env-flap{ position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:0; border-left:130px solid transparent; border-right:130px solid transparent; border-top:90px solid #e9b9cf; transform-origin:top; transition:transform .6s ease; z-index:3;}
  .env-letter{ position:absolute; left:14px; right:14px; bottom:6px; height:120px; background:#fffaf5; border-radius:6px; box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.2); transition:transform .6s ease .1s; z-index:2;}
  .envelope.opened .env-flap{ transform:rotateX(180deg);}
  .envelope.opened .env-letter{ transform:translateY(-70px);}
  .seal{ position:absolute; top:36px; left:50%; transform:translate(-50%,0); width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold-soft),var(--gold)); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:16px; z-index:4; box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3);}
  .letter-paper{ max-width:320px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffaf5,#fdf1e9); color:#5a2f22; border-radius:12px; padding:26px 22px; text-align:left;
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif; font-size:18px; line-height:1.65; box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45); white-space:pre-line;}

  /* ---------- SCREEN 9 : FINAL ---------- */

  /* cute css-drawn teddy bear duo for the final page */
  .teddy-duo{ display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:center; gap:2px; margin:16px auto 4px; }
  .teddy{ position:relative; width:78px; height:98px; }
  .teddy-body{ position:absolute; bottom:0; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); width:62px; height:56px;
    border-radius:46% 46% 42% 42%; box-shadow:inset 0 -10px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25);}
  .teddy-head{ position:absolute; top:2px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); width:50px; height:46px; border-radius:50%;
    box-shadow:inset 0 -8px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.1), 0 6px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.2);}
  .teddy-ear{ position:absolute; top:-6px; width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:50%; box-shadow:0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.18);}
  .teddy-ear.left{ left:0px;} .teddy-ear.right{ right:0px;}
  .teddy-eye{ position:absolute; top:18px; width:4px; height:4px; border-radius:50%; background:#3a1024;}
  .teddy-eye.left{ left:15px;} .teddy-eye.right{ right:15px;}
  .teddy-nose{ position:absolute; top:25px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); width:9px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:#5a2340;}
  .teddy-bow{ position:absolute; top:6px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(2deg); width:14px; height:9px; border-radius:2px;
    background:var(--gold); box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.25); z-index:2;}
  .teddy-bow::before, .teddy-bow::after{ content:''; position:absolute; top:-3px; width:9px; height:9px; background:var(--gold-soft); border-radius:50% 50% 50% 0;}
  .teddy-bow::before{ left:-8px; transform:rotate(-35deg);}
  .teddy-bow::after{ right:-8px; transform:rotate(35deg) scaleX(-1);}
  .teddy-a .teddy-body, .teddy-a .teddy-head, .teddy-a .teddy-ear{ background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f3c9d6,#e29ab4);}
  @keyframes pulseHeart{ 0%,100%{transform:scale(1);} 50%{transform:scale(1.18);} }

  /* falling hearts canvas */
  #fall-canvas{ position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:15; pointer-events:none;}

  /* confetti canvas (shared) */
  #fx-canvas{ position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:16; pointer-events:none;}

  .music-btn{ position:fixed; top:16px; right:16px; z-index:30; width:42px; height:42px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid rgba(247,219,229,.35);
    background:rgba(43,10,31,.55); color:var(--cream); font-size:17px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; cursor:pointer; backdrop-filter:blur(4px);}

  @media (max-width:360px){
    .scene-sky{ height:250px; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="ambient"></div>
<div class="page-corner"></div>
<canvas id="fx-canvas"></canvas>
<canvas id="fall-canvas"></canvas>
<button class="music-btn" id="musicToggle" aria-label="Toggle music">🔇</button>

<div id="app">

  <!-- SCREEN 1 — SCENIC INTRO (pigeon flying Vancouver → Indore with the envelope) -->
  <section class="screen active" id="screen-scene">

    <div class="fade-in" style="margin-top:10vh;">

  <section class="screen" id="screen-memories">

      <div class="gallery" id="gallery"></div>

      <div class="eyebrow">from the heart</div>

  <section class="screen" id="screen-final">
    <div class="fade-in" style="margin-top:8vh; width:100%;">
      <h1 class="title" id="finalTitle">Happy Birthday, Khadija! 🎂❤️</h1>

      <div class="teddy-duo">
        <div class="teddy teddy-a">
          <div class="teddy-ear left"></div>
          <div class="teddy-ear right"></div>
          <div class="teddy-head">
            <div class="teddy-eye left"></div>
            <div class="teddy-eye right"></div>
            <div class="teddy-nose"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="teddy-bow"></div>
          <div class="teddy-body"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <p class="subtitle script-text" style="font-size:19px; margin-top:6px;">
        With lots of love and best wishes 💕<br>
        Once again, Happy Birthday, Khadija! 🎂<br>
        Enjoy your day! ✨
      </p>
      <button class="glow-btn secondary" id="restartBtn" style="margin-top:24px;">Watch My Surprise Again 🔄</button>
    </div>
  </section>

</div>

<script>
/* =====================================================================
   EDITABLE CONTENT — change anything in this section freely
   ===================================================================== */
const BIRTHDAY_NAME = "Khadija";

// Add / remove / reorder photos here. src uses the images provided.
const MEMORY_PHOTOS = [
  { src: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", caption: "So many smiles together" },
  { src: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", caption: "One of my favorite days" },
  { src: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", caption: "Just us, being us" },
  { src: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", caption: "A moment I never want to forget" },
  { src: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", caption: "This friendship, always" }
];

const BIRTHDAY_WISHES = [
  "You deserve all the happiness in the world. 💕",
  "May this year bring you endless reasons to smile. ✨",
  "May every dream in your heart find its way to you. 🌸",
  "You deserve the entire universe and more. 🌙✨"
];

const PERSONAL_LETTER = `May you get paisa, gaadi, mehenga ghar,
Aur life mein kabhi na aaye koi "budget" wala dar! 😜
Har din ho luxury, aur weekend ho full power! 😎

May your jawaani stays deewani,
May your sham stays mastani,
Har subah ho suhani,
Aur har raat ho party wali kahaani! 🥂💃🏻

May your zindagi ho badi,
Khushiyon se bhari aur tension se thodi si khadi! 😂

May you do bade bade shehar mein, choti choti baatein,
Kabhi Paris ki coffee, kabhi Dubai ki raatein,
Aur Instagram pe chalti rahein tumhari hi baatein! ✈️✨

May your ghar ho mehenga, car ho classy,
Aur tumhari life ho hamesha thodi si sassy! 😎

May wrinkles aayein sirf smile karne se,
May calories disappear sirf khana khane se! 😂
Aur age ka number badhe,
Par dil kahe — "Abhi toh main jawaan hoon!" 💃🏻🔥

May every year bring you
more money, more memories, more madness,
more travel and absolutely NO sadness! ❤️

Happy Birthday, sweetheart! 🥂✨
Stay young, stay crazy, stay fabulous —
🎂💃🏻`;

// Leave empty to use the built-in gentle chime melody, or set to a URL/base64 of your own mp3.
const BIRTHDAY_MUSIC = "";

/* ===================================================================== */

document.getElementById('welcomeTitle').textContent = `Surprise for You, ${BIRTHDAY_NAME}! 🎁`;
document.getElementById('cakeTitle').textContent = `Happy Birthday, ${BIRTHDAY_NAME}! 🎂💕`;
document.getElementById('finalTitle').textContent = `Happy Birthday, ${BIRTHDAY_NAME}! 🎂❤️`;
document.getElementById('scratchTitleText').textContent = `Happy Birthday, ${BIRTHDAY_NAME}! 🎂💕`;
document.getElementById('letterPaper').textContent = PERSONAL_LETTER;

/* soft blurred photo backdrop (welcome screen only) */
(function initBackdrops(){
  const welcomeBd = document.getElementById('welcomeBackdrop');
  const pick1 = MEMORY_PHOTOS[0] ? MEMORY_PHOTOS[0].src : '';
  if(welcomeBd && pick1){
    welcomeBd.style.backgroundImage = `url(${pick1})`;
    setTimeout(()=> welcomeBd.classList.add('show'), 250);
  }
})();

/* ---------------- navigation (flip-book page turn) ---------------- */
function showScreen(id){
  const current = document.querySelector('.screen.active');
  const target = document.getElementById(id);
  if(!target || target === current) return;

  // place the next page underneath, already at rest, ready to be revealed
  target.style.display = 'flex';
  target.scrollTop = 0;
  target.classList.add('active');

  if(current){
    current.classList.remove('active');
    void current.offsetWidth; // force reflow so the flip transition triggers
    current.classList.add('leaving'); // flips the old page up and away, revealing target beneath
    setTimeout(()=>{
      current.classList.remove('leaving');
      current.style.display = 'none';
      current.style.transform = '';
    }, 700);
  }
}

/* ---------------- ambient floating decor ---------------- */
(function ambient(){
  const wrap = document.getElementById('ambient');
  const glyphs = ['✦','✧','♥','❀'];
  for(let i=0;i<22;i++){
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    const g = glyphs[Math.floor(Math.random()*glyphs.length)];
    el.textContent = g;
    el.className = 'amb-item ' + (g==='♥' ? 'amb-heart' : 'amb-star');
    const size = 10 + Math.random()*16;
    el.style.fontSize = size+'px';
    el.style.left = Math.random()*100+'%';
    el.style.top = Math.random()*100+'%';
    el.style.animation = `driftY ${8+Math.random()*10}s ease-in-out infinite`;
    el.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*6)+'s';
    wrap.appendChild(el);
  }
  const styleEl = document.createElement('style');
  styleEl.textContent = `@keyframes driftY{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg);}50%{transform:translateY(-22px) rotate(12deg);}}`;
  document.head.appendChild(styleEl);
})();

/* ---------------- confetti / hearts fx canvas ---------------- */
const fxCanvas = document.getElementById('fx-canvas');
const fxCtx = fxCanvas.getContext('2d');
function resizeCanvases(){
  fxCanvas.width = window.innerWidth; fxCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  fallCanvas.width = window.innerWidth; fallCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
let fxParticles = [];
function burst(x, y, opts={}){
  const count = opts.count || 26;
  const colors = opts.colors || ['#d9a857','#c6577d','#f7dbe5','#e88fab'];
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const angle = Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    const speed = 2 + Math.random()*4;
    fxParticles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle)*speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle)*speed - 2,
      life: 60 + Math.random()*30,
      age: 0,
      size: 4 + Math.random()*5,
      color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random()*colors.length)],
      shape: opts.hearts ? 'heart' : (Math.random()>.5 ? 'rect':'circle'),
      rot: Math.random()*Math.PI
    });
  }
}
function heartPath(ctx, s){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, s*0.3);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(0,0, -s,0, -s, s*0.3);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(-s, s*0.7, 0, s*0.9, 0, s*1.2);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(0, s*0.9, s, s*0.7, s, s*0.3);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(s,0, 0,0, 0, s*0.3);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function fxLoop(){
  fxCtx.clearRect(0,0,fxCanvas.width, fxCanvas.height);
  fxParticles.forEach(p=>{
    p.age++; p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy; p.vy += 0.06;
    const alpha = Math.max(0, 1 - p.age/p.life);
    fxCtx.save();
    fxCtx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    fxCtx.translate(p.x,p.y);
    fxCtx.rotate(p.rot + p.age*0.05);
    fxCtx.fillStyle = p.color;
    if(p.shape==='heart'){ heartPath(fxCtx, p.size*0.5); fxCtx.fill(); }
    else if(p.shape==='rect'){ fxCtx.fillRect(-p.size/2,-p.size/2,p.size,p.size*0.6); }
    else { fxCtx.beginPath(); fxCtx.arc(0,0,p.size/2,0,Math.PI*2); fxCtx.fill(); }
    fxCtx.restore();
  });
  fxParticles = fxParticles.filter(p=>p.age<p.life);
  requestAnimationFrame(fxLoop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(fxLoop);

/* gentle continuous falling hearts/petals for final screen */
const fallCanvas = document.getElementById('fall-canvas');
const fallCtx = fallCanvas.getContext('2d');
let fallActive = false;
let fallItems = [];
function seedFall(){
  fallItems = [];
  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
    fallItems.push({
      x: Math.random()*window.innerWidth,
      y: Math.random()*-window.innerHeight,
      vy: 0.6+Math.random()*1.2,
      vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.6,
      size: 8+Math.random()*10,
      color: Math.random()>.5 ? '#e88fab' : '#d9a857',
      shape: Math.random()>.5 ? 'heart':'petal',
      rot: Math.random()*Math.PI, spin:(Math.random()-.5)*0.02
    });
  }
}
function fallLoop(){
  fallCtx.clearRect(0,0,fallCanvas.width, fallCanvas.height);
  if(fallActive){
    fallItems.forEach(p=>{
      p.y += p.vy; p.x += p.vx; p.rot += p.spin;
      if(p.y > window.innerHeight+20){ p.y = -20; p.x = Math.random()*window.innerWidth; }
      fallCtx.save();
      fallCtx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
      fallCtx.translate(p.x,p.y);
      fallCtx.rotate(p.rot);
      fallCtx.fillStyle = p.color;
      if(p.shape==='heart'){ heartPath(fallCtx, p.size*0.5); fallCtx.fill(); }
      else { fallCtx.beginPath(); fallCtx.ellipse(0,0,p.size*0.5,p.size*0.3,0,0,Math.PI*2); fallCtx.fill(); }
      fallCtx.restore();
    });
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(fallLoop);
}
resizeCanvases();
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvases);
requestAnimationFrame(fallLoop);

/* ---------------- music (gentle original chime, Web Audio) ---------------- */
let audioCtx = null;
let musicPlaying = false;
let audioEl = null;
if(BIRTHDAY_MUSIC){
  audioEl = new Audio(BIRTHDAY_MUSIC);
  audioEl.loop = true;
  audioEl.volume = 0.35;
}
function ensureAudioCtx(){ if(!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); }
function wakeAudio(){ ensureAudioCtx(); if(audioCtx.state==='suspended') audioCtx.resume(); }

/* short reusable sound effects (no external files, no copyright concerns) */
function playTone(freq, dur, type, vol, glideTo){
  wakeAudio();
  const t = audioCtx.currentTime;
  const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
  osc.type = type || 'sine';
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
  if(glideTo) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(glideTo, t+dur*0.8);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t);
  gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol||0.12, t+0.012);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t+dur);
  osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
  osc.start(t); osc.stop(t+dur+0.05);
}
function sfxClick(){ playTone(520, 0.07, 'sine', 0.07); }
function sfxTap(){ playTone(700, 0.09, 'sine', 0.09); }
function sfxPop(){ playTone(900, 0.16, 'triangle', 0.16, 130); }
function sfxCandle(){ playTone(480, 0.26, 'sine', 0.11, 190); }
function sfxWrong(){ playTone(220, 0.22, 'sawtooth', 0.08, 160); }
function sfxChime(){
  [659.25, 880, 1046.5].forEach((f,i)=> setTimeout(()=> playTone(f, 0.35, 'sine', 0.12), i*95));
}
/* "Happy Birthday to You" melody (traditional folk tune, public domain) — synthesized live, no audio file needed */
const HBD_MELODY = [
  [392.00,0.32],[392.00,0.28],[440.00,0.55],[392.00,0.55],[523.25,0.55],[493.88,0.95],[0,0.22],
  [392.00,0.32],[392.00,0.28],[440.00,0.55],[392.00,0.55],[587.33,0.55],[523.25,0.95],[0,0.22],
  [392.00,0.32],[392.00,0.28],[783.99,0.55],[659.25,0.55],[523.25,0.55],[493.88,0.55],[440.00,0.95],[0,0.22],
  [698.46,0.32],[698.46,0.28],[659.25,0.55],[523.25,0.55],[587.33,0.55],[523.25,1.0],[0,0.7]
];
let musicTimeouts = [];
function playNote(freq, dur){
  if(!freq) return; // rest
  const t = audioCtx.currentTime;
  const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t);
  gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.14, t+0.03);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0008, t+dur);
  gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
  // warm music-box tone: fundamental sine + soft triangle overtone
  const osc1 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  osc1.type = 'sine'; osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
  const osc2 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
  osc2.type = 'triangle'; osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq*2, t);
  const gain2 = audioCtx.createGain(); gain2.gain.value = 0.35;
  osc1.connect(gain); osc2.connect(gain2); gain2.connect(gain);
  osc1.start(t); osc1.stop(t+dur+0.05);
  osc2.start(t); osc2.stop(t+dur+0.05);
}
function scheduleHBD(){
  let t = 0;
  HBD_MELODY.forEach(([freq,dur])=>{
    const id = setTimeout(()=>{ if(musicPlaying) playNote(freq, dur*0.9); }, t*1000);
    musicTimeouts.push(id);
    t += dur;
  });
  const loopId = setTimeout(()=>{ if(musicPlaying) scheduleHBD(); }, t*1000);
  musicTimeouts.push(loopId);
}
function startBuiltInMusic(){
  wakeAudio();
  stopBuiltInMusic();
  scheduleHBD();
}
function stopBuiltInMusic(){
  musicTimeouts.forEach(id=> clearTimeout(id));
  musicTimeouts = [];
}
function setMusic(on){
  musicPlaying = on;
  document.getElementById('musicToggle').textContent = on ? '🔊' : '🔇';
  if(audioEl){
    if(on) audioEl.play().catch(()=>{}); else audioEl.pause();
  } else {
    if(on) startBuiltInMusic(); else stopBuiltInMusic();
  }
}
document.getElementById('musicToggle').addEventListener('click', ()=> setMusic(!musicPlaying));
document.getElementById('musicHintBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  setMusic(true);
  document.getElementById('musicHintBtn').style.display='none';
});

/* ---------------- SCREEN 1 : pigeon journey + envelope open ---------------- */
(function initSceneJourney(){
  const pigeon = document.getElementById('pigeon');
  const drop = document.getElementById('envelopeDrop');
  if(!pigeon || !drop) return;
  pigeon.addEventListener('animationend', function handler(){
    pigeon.removeEventListener('animationend', handler);
    drop.classList.add('show');
  }, {once:true});
})();
document.getElementById('sceneEnvelope').addEventListener('click', function(){
  const env = this;
  if(env.classList.contains('opened')) return;
  wakeAudio();
  sfxTap();
  env.classList.add('opened');
  const rect = env.getBoundingClientRect();
  burst(rect.left+rect.width/2, rect.top, {count:26, hearts:true});
  setTimeout(()=> showScreen('screen-welcome'), 750);
});

/* ---------------- SCREEN 2 : gift open ---------------- */
document.getElementById('giftWrap').addEventListener('click', function(){
  const gift = this;
  if(gift.classList.contains('opened')) return;
  wakeAudio();
  sfxChime();
  gift.classList.add('opened');
  const rect = gift.getBoundingClientRect();
  burst(rect.left+rect.width/2, rect.top+rect.height/2, {count:40, hearts:true});
  setTimeout(()=>{
    burst(window.innerWidth/2, window.innerHeight*0.3, {count:36});
  }, 200);
  setTimeout(()=> { showScreen('screen-scratch'); initScratch(); }, 1100);
});

/* ---------------- SCREEN 3 : cake candles ---------------- */
let candlesInit = false;
function initCandles(){
  if(candlesInit) return; candlesInit = true;
  const wrap = document.getElementById('candles');
  const count = 5;
  let blown = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const c = document.createElement('div');
    c.className = 'candle';
    const flame = document.createElement('div');
    flame.className = 'flame';
    c.appendChild(flame);
    c.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if(c.classList.contains('blown')) return;
      sfxCandle();
      c.classList.add('blown');
      blown++;
      const rect = c.getBoundingClientRect();
      burst(rect.left+rect.width/2, rect.top, {count:14, hearts: i%2===0});
      if(blown===count){
        setTimeout(()=>{
          sfxChime();
          const bRect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
          burst(bRect.left+bRect.width/2, bRect.top+20, {count:50, hearts:true});
          document.getElementById('candleHint').classList.add('hide');
          document.getElementById('makeWish').classList.add('show');
          const btn = document.getElementById('cakeContinueBtn');
          btn.style.opacity = 1; btn.style.pointerEvents='auto';
        }, 300);
      }
    });
    wrap.appendChild(c);
  }
}
document.getElementById('cakeContinueBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  showScreen('screen-balloons');
});

/* ---------------- SCREEN 4 : memories gallery ---------------- */
(function initGallery(){
  const gallery = document.getElementById('gallery');
  const dotsRow = document.getElementById('galleryDots');
  MEMORY_PHOTOS.forEach((m,i)=>{
    const fig = document.createElement('figure');
    fig.className = 'polaroid';
    fig.style.setProperty('--tilt', (i%2===0 ? '-3deg':'3deg'));
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.src = m.src; img.alt = m.caption; img.loading = 'lazy';
    const cap = document.createElement('figcaption');
    cap.textContent = m.caption;
    fig.appendChild(img); fig.appendChild(cap);
    fig.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      fig.classList.add('tapped');
      const rect = fig.getBoundingClientRect();
      burst(rect.left+rect.width/2, rect.top+rect.height/2, {count:18, hearts:true});
      setTimeout(()=>fig.classList.remove('tapped'), 900);
    });
    gallery.appendChild(fig);
    const dot = document.createElement('span');
    dotsRow.appendChild(dot);
  });
  let hintFaded = false;
  gallery.addEventListener('scroll', ()=>{
    if(hintFaded) return;
    hintFaded = true;
    const hint = document.getElementById('swipeHint');
    if(hint) hint.style.opacity = '0';
  }, {passive:true});
})();
document.getElementById('memoriesContinueBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  showScreen('screen-letter');
});

/* ---------------- SCREEN 5 : balloons ---------------- */
(function initBalloons(){
  const field = document.getElementById('balloonField');
  const colors = ['#c6577d','#d9a857','#e6a4bd','#7a2245','#f0d9ae','#b5446e'];
  const positions = [
    {left:'4%', top:'2%'}, {left:'55%', top:'0%'}, {left:'2%', top:'40%'},
    {left:'60%', top:'42%'}, {left:'20%', top:'70%'}, {left:'62%', top:'75%'}
  ];
  let popped = 0;
  BIRTHDAY_WISHES.forEach((wish,i)=>{
    const b = document.createElement('div');
    b.className = 'balloon';
    b.style.background = `radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, ${colors[i%colors.length]}dd, ${colors[i%colors.length]})`;
    b.style.left = positions[i%positions.length].left;
    b.style.top = positions[i%positions.length].top;
    b.style.animationDelay = (i*0.3)+'s';
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if(b.classList.contains('pop')) return;
      sfxPop();
      b.classList.add('pop');
      const rect = b.getBoundingClientRect();
      burst(rect.left+rect.width/2, rect.top+rect.height/2, {count:22, hearts:true});
      popped++;
      document.getElementById('balloonCounter').textContent = `Popped ${popped} / ${BIRTHDAY_WISHES.length}`;
      showWishToast(wish, rect.left+rect.width/2, rect.top+rect.height/2);
      if(popped===BIRTHDAY_WISHES.length){
        setTimeout(()=>{
          const btn = document.getElementById('balloonsContinueBtn');
          btn.style.opacity=1; btn.style.pointerEvents='auto';
          document.querySelector('#screen-balloons .subtitle').textContent = `You found all the wishes! 💕`;
        }, 400);
      }
    });
    field.appendChild(b);
  });
})();
function showWishToast(text, x, y){
  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  toast.className = 'wish-toast';
  toast.textContent = text;
  toast.style.left = x + 'px';
  toast.style.top = y + 'px';
  document.body.appendChild(toast);
  requestAnimationFrame(()=> toast.classList.add('show'));
  setTimeout(()=>{
    toast.classList.remove('show');
    setTimeout(()=> toast.remove(), 400);
  }, 2200);
}
document.getElementById('balloonsContinueBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  showScreen('screen-memories');
});

/* ---------------- SCREEN 7 : scratch reveal ---------------- */
let scratchInit = false;
function initScratch(){
  if(scratchInit) return; scratchInit = true;
  const canvas = document.getElementById('scratchCanvas');
  const wrap = document.getElementById('scratchWrap');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  function size(){
    canvas.width = wrap.clientWidth; canvas.height = wrap.clientHeight;
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    grad.addColorStop(0,'#7a2245'); grad.addColorStop(1,'#3f1330');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(247,219,229,.85)';
    ctx.font = '600 15px Quicksand, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('✦ swipe to reveal ✦', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2);
  }
  size();
  let drawing = false;
  let revealed = 0;
  let checkTimer = null;
  function scratchAt(x,y){
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x,y,22,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  function getPos(e){
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
    return { x: p.clientX-rect.left, y: p.clientY-rect.top };
  }
  function start(e){ drawing = true; move(e); }
  function move(e){
    if(!drawing) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const pos = getPos(e);
    scratchAt(pos.x,pos.y);
    clearTimeout(checkTimer);
    checkTimer = setTimeout(checkReveal, 200);
  }
  function end(){ drawing = false; }
  function checkReveal(){
    const data = ctx.getImageData(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height).data;
    let clear = 0;
    for(let i=3;i<data.length;i+=4*20){ if(data[i]===0) clear++; }
    const ratio = clear / (data.length/(4*20));
    if(ratio > 0.45 && !revealed){
      revealed = 1;
      sfxChime();
      canvas.style.transition = 'opacity .5s ease';
      canvas.style.opacity = 0;
      const rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      burst(rect.left+rect.width/2, rect.top+rect.height/2, {count:30, hearts:true});
      document.getElementById('scratchHint').textContent = `You found the hidden surprise! 🥹❤️`;
      const btn = document.getElementById('scratchContinueBtn');
      btn.style.opacity=1; btn.style.pointerEvents='auto';
    }
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', start);
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', move);
  window.addEventListener('mouseup', end);
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', start, {passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', move, {passive:false});
  canvas.addEventListener('touchend', end);
  window.addEventListener('resize', size);
}
document.getElementById('scratchContinueBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  showScreen('screen-cake'); initCandles();
});

/* ---------------- SCREEN 8 : letter envelope ---------------- */
document.getElementById('envelope').addEventListener('click', function(){
  const env = this;
  if(env.classList.contains('opened')) return;
  sfxTap();
  env.classList.add('opened');
  const rect = env.getBoundingClientRect();
  burst(rect.left+rect.width/2, rect.top, {count:26, hearts:true});
  setTimeout(()=>{
    env.style.display='none';
    document.getElementById('letterCardHolder').style.display='block';
  }, 750);
});
document.getElementById('letterContinueBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  showScreen('screen-final'); initFinal();
});

/* ---------------- SCREEN 9 : final ---------------- */
let finalInit = false;
function initFinal(){
  fallActive = true;
  seedFall();
  if(finalInit) return; finalInit = true;
  burst(window.innerWidth/2, window.innerHeight*0.25, {count:60, hearts:true});
}
document.getElementById('restartBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  fallActive = false;
  // reset candle state
  candlesInit = false;
  document.getElementById('candles').innerHTML = '';
  document.getElementById('candleHint').classList.remove('hide');
  document.getElementById('makeWish').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('cakeContinueBtn').style.opacity=.4;
  document.getElementById('cakeContinueBtn').style.pointerEvents='none';
  // reset balloons
  document.querySelectorAll('.balloon').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('pop'));
  document.getElementById('balloonCounter').textContent = `Popped 0 / ${BIRTHDAY_WISHES.length}`;
  document.getElementById('balloonsContinueBtn').style.opacity=.4;
  document.getElementById('balloonsContinueBtn').style.pointerEvents='none';
  document.querySelector('#screen-balloons .subtitle').textContent = 'Tap each balloon to reveal a little wish.';
  // reset scratch
  scratchInit = false;
  document.getElementById('scratchContinueBtn').style.opacity=.4;
  document.getElementById('scratchContinueBtn').style.pointerEvents='none';
  document.getElementById('scratchHint').textContent = 'Swipe your finger over the card ✨';
  // reset envelope
  const env = document.getElementById('envelope');
  env.classList.remove('opened');
  env.style.display='flex';
  document.getElementById('letterCardHolder').style.display='none';
  // reset gift
  document.getElementById('giftWrap').classList.remove('opened');

  showScreen('screen-welcome');
});

/* generic soft click sound on all main action buttons */
document.querySelectorAll('.glow-btn, .icon-btn, .music-hint').forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener('click', ()=> sfxClick());
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
